shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!vendor'"' -g '"'!dist'"' | sort | sed -n '1,160p'; printf '\\n--- product page ---\\n'; sed -n '1,240p' app/product/page.tsx; printf '\\n--- refs ---\\n'; rg -n \"getRelatedProducts|getFeatured|featured|router\\.prefetch|prefetch\\(|<Link|next/link|product\" app components lib src -g '"'!node_modules'"' 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,240p'; printf '\\n--- package ---\\n'; cat package.json"

/bin/bash -c "printf '%s\\n' '--- lib/data.ts ---'; sed -n '1,240p' lib/data.ts; printf '%s\\n' '--- app/page.tsx ---'; sed -n '1,200p' app/page.tsx; printf '%s\\n' '--- layout ---'; sed -n '1,200p' app/layout.tsx; printf '%s\\n' '--- config ---'; cat next.config.ts; printf '%s\\n' '--- git ---'; git status --short; find .. -name AGENTS.md -print"
/bin/bash -c 'npx tsc --noEmit && git diff -- app/page.tsx app/featured-product-link.tsx && git status --short'

/bin/bash -c "npm run build && printf '\\n--- changed paths ---\\n' && git status --short && printf '\\n--- references ---\\n' && rg -n \"FeaturedProductLink|prefetch=|prefetchProduct|onMouseEnter|onFocus|onTouchStart\" app/page.tsx app/featured-product-link.tsx"
